findings_qualitative.value: Filaments A-E cannot be represented by a single infalling stream, consistent with chaotic cold accretion

evidence.quote: seems to be hardly reproduced by a single stream of infalling gas since all the components are not aligned in the same position angle

findings_qualitative.value: Blue-shifted HCN/HCO+ absorption by 300-600 km/s against the jet suggests outflowing gas

evidence.quote: The absorption features are blue-shifted from the systemic velocity by $\sim$300-600 km s$^{-1}$, suggesting the presence of outflowing gas

claims.hypothesis: Is there a massive rotating cold gas disk in the central 100 pc?
claims.experiment: Imaging of CO(2-1), HCN(3-2), HCO+(3-2) at ~20 pc resolution
claims.result: Velocity gradient ~±250 km/s at PA~70 deg; H2 mass ~4e8 Msun
claims.finding: A rotating molecular disk exists, with axis roughly aligned with the jet

evidence.quote: Within the central 100 pc, we detected a rotational disk of the molecular gas whose mass is $\sim10^{8}~M_{\ensuremath{\odot}}$.

claims.hypothesis: Is cold accretion more important than hot (Bondi) accretion?
claims.experiment: Crude accretion rate estimates from gas mass and timescales
claims.result: Mdot > 0.1 Msun/yr (kpc) and 1-10 Msun/yr (disk) versus Bondi 7.4e-5

evidence.quote: A crude estimate suggests that the accretion rate of the cold gas can be higher than that of hot gas.

claims.experiment: Spectra at the continuum peak, checked without continuum subtraction and in archival data
claims.result: Absorption at 4600-4900 km/s, >3 sigma HCN and >4 sigma HCO+; marginal in archive
claims.finding: Likely jet-cloud interaction or CND outflow

evidence.quote: The significance is more than $3\sigma$ and $4\sigma$ at the deepest absorption channels for HCN(3-2) and HCO$^{+}$(3-2), respectively.

claims.hypothesis: What is the SMBH mass from molecular gas dynamics?
claims.experiment: KinMS disk modelling of the CO cube with MGE stellar mass
claims.finding: Agrees with warm H2 dynamics, disagrees with virial BLR mass

evidence.quote: The measured SMBH is $1\times10^{9}~M_{\ensuremath{\odot}}$, which agrees with the dynamical measurement using the warm H$_{2}$ gas but disagrees with the virial mass estimate using broad emission lines.

why_this_data.value: High-resolution ALMA needed to resolve inner kpc to <50 pc scale

evidence.quote: High resolution observations of the cold molecular gas with ALMA are key to uncovering the missing link between the outer kpc and the inner $\lesssim50$ pc
we obtain the total gas mass of $\sim$5-7$\times10^{7} M_{\ensuremath{\odot}}$

limitations_admitted.value: Missing flux from lack of short baselines, so masses are lower limits

evidence.quote: Note that the estimated mass should be a lower limit since the total emissions cannot be recovered because of the lack of short interferometric baselines.

limitations_admitted.value: Residual is not a true chi2 because neighbouring pixels are correlated; modelling assumptions simple

evidence.quote: This residual is useful to judge the fitting results but is not equivalent to the $\chi^{2}$, as the neighboring pixels in the observed cube are correlated.

referee_caveats_inferred: Accretion rates are crude order-of-magnitude estimates with large alpha_CO uncertainty
SMBH error from rescaled residuals, not a proper chi2 or MCMC; inclination hits search limit
Absorption significance only 3-4 sigma and marginal in archive
Self-calibration on a variable source may affect line and absorption fluxes
